::: {#lem-rss-gradient-vector}
#### Gradient of RSS in vector notation

The gradient of the residual sum of squares in vector notation (@exm-rss-vector) is

$$\deriv{\vcoef} \text{RSS}(\vcoef)
= -2 \sumin \vxi \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-rss-gradient-vector.

:::
